features.name: Sand Form
features.description:
At 2nd level, expend one Wild Shape as bonus action to become animated sand for 10 min (1 hour at L10). Move through 1-inch spaces. Advantage to escape grapple/restrained.

Bonus actions while in sand form:
- **Abrasive Blast:** Ranged spell attack, 30 ft, 1d8 + WIS slashing (2d8 at L10)
- **Stinging Cloud:** Creature within 5 ft (10 ft at L10) makes CON save or is blinded until end of next turn

features.name: Diffuse Form
features.description: Also at 2nd level, while in Sand Form, when hit by a weapon attack, use reaction to gain resistance to nonmagical B/P/S until start of next turn. Prof bonus uses/long rest.

payload.name: Diffuse Form
payload.description: Gain resistance to nonmagical B/P/S until start of next turn (Sand Form only).

features.name: Sand Dervish
features.description: At 6th level, create a 10-ft tall, 5-ft wide cylinder of whirling sand within 30 ft. Creatures ending turn within 5 ft make STR save: 1d8 slashing (2d8 at L10) and pushed 10 ft on fail (half, no push on success). Move it 30 ft as bonus action. 1/short or long rest.

features.name: Echo of the Dunes
features.description:
At 10th level, choose one (1/short or long rest):
- **Sand Sphere:** 20-ft radius heavily obscured sphere, 3 ft movement per 1 ft, 1 min
- **Whirlwind:** Transform until start of next turn; doubled speed, no OA, resistance to all damage, can't be grappled/petrified/prone/restrained/stunned, but can't attack or cast

features.name: Sandstorm
features.description: At 14th level, create a 30-ft radius, 10-ft tall cylinder of sandstorm within 120 ft. Heavily obscured, difficult terrain. Creatures entering or starting turn: STR save, 2d8 slashing + prone on fail (half, no prone on success). You and chosen allies (prof bonus) are immune. 1 min. 1/long rest.
